item.title: $28M worth of cocaine captured in largest seizure by small boat station in Florida: USCG
item.description: MIAMI, Fla. (WFLA)— The U.S. Coast Guard Station Miami Beach had the largest cocaine seizure by a small boat station on Tuesday.
